description: Wastewater Generation and Treatment is a dataset listed in Bahrain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Ministry of Works. Wastewater Generation and Treatment (1,000 Cubic Meter Per Day). Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under Energy and Water. Its keywords are Water. The portal shows 364 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
